_readme: One file per song per version: deliveries/<Song>/session/mix_config_vN.json. EVERY parameter needs value + why (the measurement that justified it, on THIS song) + source (measured | reference | artist_request | carried_from_vN) + since (version it was set/changed). Values here are placeholders (null) on purpose: never copy numbers from another song.

title.why: Kenshin named the song in the group chat (fresh run)

bpm.why: tempo_key.py on the beat: 135.00 (alts 67.5/90). Long self-match of the beat (1-6 kHz band) at 8-96 bars: 96-bar drift -0.01..0.00 samples (corr 0.92-0.97), fit 135.0000. Snare on beat 3 = half-time feel; counted as 135 (trap convention), 67.5 is the same grid at half speed. Beat = 19600 samples, bar = 78400 samples exactly at 44.1 kHz

grid_t0_sec.why: snare (1.5-4 kHz crack, beat 3) 50%-attack offset, median over 75 full-drum bars, IQR 182-183 samples. Detector bias on a synthetic snare +85 samples and kick body rise gives ~236 after bias correction, so true T0 is ~100-240 samples (2-5 ms). Not from hats

key.value: F major note set (relative D minor); tonic ambiguous F major vs G minor/Dorian
key.why: beat chroma best F major 0.83 (next G minor 0.68); tempo_key.py D minor 0.813 vs F major 0.810 (low conf). 808 loop G-Bb-F-C, 2 bars each (Gm-Bb-F-C), starts on G. Sung pitch classes mostly Bb/G/A/C/F, no Eb, no E. Confidence: medium on notes, low on tonic

sections.name: Bridge: Background lead / BG2 trade 2 bars

reference_tracks.title: W.O.W (Walkin On Water) - Chris Travis
reference_tracks.valid_reason: 16-bit/44.1k but spectrum stops ~15-16 kHz (made from lossy sources): used loosely for top end; no vocal stems, so no vocal-pocket delta can be read from them

reference_tracks.title: FijiFalls - Chris Travis x Bones
reference_tracks.valid_reason: 16-bit/44.1k but spectrum stops ~15-16 kHz (made from lossy sources): used loosely for top end; no vocal stems, so no vocal-pocket delta can be read from them

reference_tracks.title: I Don't Wanna Do This Anymore - XXXTENTACION
reference_tracks.valid_reason: 16-bit/44.1k but spectrum stops ~15-16 kHz (made from lossy sources): used loosely for top end; no vocal stems, so no vocal-pocket delta can be read from them

echoes.why: NOT DECIDED: ask Kenshin how he wants echoes on this song (no default)

value.method: demucs htdemucs two-stem separation of each Kenshin WAV; metric = LUFS(vocal) - LUFS(instrumental) over 3 s windows where the vocal sings and the instrumental is full; calibrated on our own v1 mix (true -1.02 LU, separated -0.89 -> bias +0.13 LU; midband bias +0.72 dB)

references_pocket_measured.why: requested measurement of the lead-vs-beat relationship in the 3 references. They sit LOUDER than our v1 (median -0.19 LU vs v1 -1.0), so they argue against a cut; noted honestly; the v2 cut follows Kenshin's direct ear note. Low-to-medium confidence (separation on lossy mastered mixes).

printed_fx_on_vocals.why: pooled post-phrase envelope: -23 dB re phrase at 50 ms, still -45 dB at ~600 ms (~40 dB/s, ~RT60 1.5 s) vs a dry known-answer test that falls 30 dB in 10 ms; median time to -40 dB 510-640 ms (leads/bg1), 340 ms (bg2). Tails are then truncated to digital zero 0.4-0.65 s after the phrase (region ends). Vocals are dual-mono (L=R), so no printed stereo FX

lossy_source.why: beat bandwidth 15.6 kHz (-40 dB) / 16.6 kHz (-60 dB), filename 'Y2Mate...160k'; ALL vocals stop at 16.0-16.5 kHz too (lossy export path)

copy_pasted_regions.what: beat: whole arrangement is a repeated loop

timing_vs_grid_ms_by_section._note: raw librosa onset medians vs the 1/16 grid; detector read +10 ms late on a known-answer test, so subtract ~10 ms; IQRs 25-40 ms

blockers: lossy beat (YouTube 160k rip) and lossy vocals (16 kHz bandwidth); air cannot be restored
printed reverb on all vocals, truncated to digital zero 0.4-0.65 s after phrases
808 fundamentals F1 43.7 / G1 49.1 / Bb1 58.5 / C2 65.9 Hz: 3 of 4 notes under 60 Hz, no 808 stem; 100-400 Hz envelope follows the 808 weakly (r=0.29)
copy-pasted vocal sections placed off the exact bar grid (+23.2 ms bars 65-73; -38.9 ms bars 89-91)
no clipping (0 runs), no DC issue (<1e-5), beat not mastered (-20.45 LUFS, PLR 17.1 dB, no flat tops)
possible producer tag / leaked vocals in the beat: not tested reliably
free type beat: lease/licence needed before release (not an audio check)
intake_findings.dry_vs_gated: regions/gated: 58% (leads) and 92-94% (BGs) of samples are exact digital zero; region edges are quiet (max -59 dBFS), but printed tails are cut to zero ~-45 dB below the phrase

vocal_roles.lead1_vs_lead2: call-and-response: alternate every 2 bars; only 10-12% of active frames overlap (hand-offs)
vocal_roles.bg1_vs_bg2: call-and-response with each other in bars 74-82 only (3% overlap)
vocal_roles.bg_vs_leads: not doubles or backing: 0-1% overlap with the leads; the 'Background lead' stems are a separate 9-bar bridge section sung on their own

tuning._calibration: known answers: snapped synthetic 92%, untuned drift 23%. Leads look partly pitch-corrected (Lead 1 more), BGs untuned; based on only ~12 s of confident pitch per lead

resonance_preview.tool: harmenv.py (What_Im_Posed_To_Do) pitch-independent harmonic envelope; Gate 1 must re-measure per section

lead_vs_beat_lu_target.why: Kenshin on the v1 preview (2026-11-25 9:09): 'This sounds really good. Just add a slight reverb and either turn the main vocals down a tad or turn the beat up. It seems kinda loud (the vocals) can't really hear the beat'. v1 target -1.0 LU -> -2.5 LU (vocals -1.5 dB). Amount capped by the Gate 1 clarity guard (800 Hz-4 kHz margin >= +3 dB in every full-beat section; smallest v1 margin A1 +4.63 dB -> max cut 1.63 dB). References do not support a cut (see references_pocket_measured); Kenshin's ear note wins.

lead_vs_beat_lu_range.why: target +-0.5 LU, set before the v2 render

midband_delta_db_target.why: 800 Hz-4 kHz vocal minus beat during singing: words clearly above the beat mids while the LU sits inside the beat; upper bound keeps it from sitting on top

lead_gain_db.why: common gain on both leads (after -18 dBFS gain staging) so the median full-beat section (A1/B1/A2/B3) lands on -1.0 LU vs the pocketed beat

beat_mid_dip.key: all vocals summed; depth = max * clip((env - (p95 - 20 dB))/10 dB, 0, 1)
beat_mid_dip.structure: Regalia-Mitra dynamic bell (x + (G-1)*bandpass), causal, zero latency
beat_mid_dip.why: masking (singing frames, after vocal gain): vocal-over-beat-mid margin by 1/3 octave {800: 9.5, 1008: 7.1, 1270: 5.9, 1600: 7.3, 2016: 3.3, 2540: 3.3, 3200: 2.2, 4032: -11.8}; 2-3.2 kHz sits 2.6-3.7 dB below the median margin, 4 kHz excluded (vocal source hole). Centre/width = those bands; depth = half the worst deficit (small move, cap 3 dB). Attack 1/128 note (13.9 ms), release 1/8 note (222.2 ms) so it closes in gaps. Note: the leads trade lines almost continuously, so inside vocal sections the dip is open most of the time (acts close to a static 1.8 dB cut there)

bus_offset_db.why: all frozen Gate 1 files (vocals and beat) carry one common -6 dB offset for headroom (attempt 2 clipped at 0 dBFS); balance unchanged; Gate 3 gain-stages the bus

pocket.why: lead vs beat per section and midband measured from the frozen files in gate1_exit_checks_v1.json

beat_mid_dip_note.value: unchanged from v1 (beat file not re-rendered)
beat_mid_dip_note.why: only vocal gains moved, so the -6 dB bus headroom and the v1 vocal-keyed beat dip stay valid; the dip was keyed by the v1 vocal level, so at -1.5 dB it would engage slightly less if re-keyed (not done: diff-only)

value.where: every region (turn) edge; 14 turns per lead, 2 per BG

edge_fades_ms.why: region starts are <= -59 dBFS and the first loud frame is >= 720 ms in, so 10 ms in touches nothing; region ends are chopped printed-reverb tails at -30.4 dB re the turn RMS (abrupt), so the longest allowed fade (15 ms) out. No breath gating.

working_level_rms_dbfs.why: standard starting point for predictable processors; raw active RMS -25.40 dBFS -> gain +7.40 dB

value.type: turn-level clip gain (gain steps sit in digital silence between turns)

rider.why: turn-level spread p90-p10 3.89 dB overall (within sections up to 4.7 dB, lead1 B1). A 250-400 ms RMS rider would ride inside turns and lift the printed reverb, so half the deviation from the stem's median turn level is corrected per whole turn, capped +-1.5 dB.

hpf.why: lowest sung fundamental 86.8 Hz (min of Gate 0 lowest-stable and p05 pitch); fc = 20% below (middle of the 15-25% guidance); 24 dB/oct because 12 dB/oct would cost >1 dB at the lowest note at any fc that still clears the 44-59 Hz 808 zone. Verified loss at lowest note in exit checks

eq_cuts.why: raw harmonic envelope: pooled hump +5.56 dB at 480 Hz (half-height ~430-530 Hz), every section +5.0..+6.2 (B1 peaks at 460). Sweep 1 (483/Q5) left the 440 Hz shoulder; sweep 2 (bell only) chose 472/Q3.8/-6; exit checks through the full chain then read pooled +2.62 and B1 +3.66. Sweep 3 (through the chain, depth fixed at the 6 dB cap, centre 466/474/482 x Q 3.4/4.2/5.0): 474 Hz Q4.2 brings B1 to ~2.2 and every section <= 3.0; NO centre/Q reaches the pooled +2.5 target at <= 6 dB (best ~2.67) -> documented as a limit, not deepened.

compressor_stages.threshold_rule: = measured active RMS of the compressor input (+0 dB)
compressor_stages.why: raw crest while singing 19.0 dB (spiky) but turn spread small; 18-setting sweep (thr -6/-3/0 re RMS, 2:1/3:1, 10/20/30 ms) under pre-set limits (punch +-1 dB, attack >= 90%, printed room <= raw+1 dB): this was the largest crest reduction that passed on both leads. Release = 1/16 note at 135 BPM (111.1 ms). BG chains use the same rule on their own RMS (verified in exit checks).

deesser.threshold: 97th percentile of the S-ness detector (band env - broadband env) over singing frames
deesser.placement: after compressor and tone EQ (LEARNINGS: de-ess last)
deesser.why: band = 1/4-octave bands whose p99 band-relative level is within ~1 dB of the stem maximum (raw scan); p90/p93 thresholds kept it on >20% of singing (sweep), p97 gives ~9-14%; release = 1/32 note (55.6 ms)

tone_boosts.why: take is very dark: 5-10 kHz vs 1-2 kHz = -18.6 dB vs beat -1.9 dB and refs -10.1/-2.8/0.0 dB (Kenshin WAVs). Closing that gap would lift lossy artifacts and sibilance (Kenshin hates harsh/scratchy), so a modest lift capped for a lossy 16 kHz source; flare and S-spike verified not above raw

voiced frames have a source hole at 3.6-5 kHz (-36 dB re 1 kHz in the median spectrum; lossy/printed processing) so presence is placed just below it, where the beat masks the vocal most (2-3.2 kHz margin lowest); +1 dB only (Kenshin: no harsh)

saturation.why: not needed: no measured phone-translation gain justifies it; Kenshin dislikes saturation/ampy vocals

pan.why: call-and-response leads and the bridge pair are single voices taking turns; no stereo width measured or requested

output_gain_db.why: v1 pocket gain -0.84 dB, then -1.5 dB (v2 level move, same on all four vocals so the bridge-vs-lead relationship is unchanged). Kenshin on the v1 preview (2026-11-25): 'turn the main vocals down a tad or turn the beat up. It seems kinda loud (the vocals), can't really hear the beat.' Vocals moved (not the beat) so the -6 dB headroom offset and the vocal-keyed beat dip stay valid. Amount = the largest cut inside the 1.5-2.5 dB 'a tad' window that keeps every full-beat section's 800 Hz-4 kHz vocal-over-beat margin >= +3.0 dB (the Gate 1 clarity guard, set before v1): smallest v1 margin A1 +4.63 -> max cut 1.63 dB -> 1.5 dB. References (demucs-separated, calibrated on our v1 mix: bias +0.13 LU) put the vocal at -0.19 LU median (-1.9..+0.43) and midband +5.9..+9.1 dB, i.e. LOUDER than v1, so they do not support a cut; Kenshin's direct ear note and history (Wild Side -0.43 LU 'too loud', v1 -1.0 LU 'kinda loud') win, and the clarity guard caps the move.

section_trim_db.why: B3 is sung ~2.5 dB hotter than A1; render attempt 1 put B3 at -0.34 LU, outside the pre-set range; trim applied to the B3 turns only (gain steps in digital silence)

value.entry: about 5-6 words into each verse, runs underneath
value.treatment: telephone tone, dreamy reverb, a few echo throws (Gate 2, Plugin/Effect Pro)
value.notes: Gate 1 stems carry the -6 dB common bus offset and the pocket gain; full length, sample-aligned to the source/beat (lag -1 sample); duplicate them, do not re-process the dry lead.
